title: 第4章 人穷志短所以行骗
content_zh:
“这手机不是我的。”

    “哦？”

    “这手机是我骗的。”谷川说道。

    刘艺菲逐渐升腾的怒气突然就停了下来。

    额，这理由好有可信度。

    谷川脸上挂着笑，看上去特真诚。

    刘艺菲拿出手机，摸索着，似乎是在拨什么号码。

    “唉！你等等！”

    谷川连忙摁住刘艺菲的手，不能让她把报警电话打出去。

    “好好好，手机号给你。”谷川不情不愿地给刘艺菲报了一个号码，刘艺菲打过去，果然是谷川，这次没有再骗人。

    谷川笑着说道：“其实我更习惯用企鹅号的，不习惯用电话。”

    刘艺菲冷哼一声。

    她对骗自己钱的人，没有任何好脸色。

    “记得还钱，不然我肯定报警。”刘艺菲凶巴巴地说道。

    “还还还。”谷川点头。

    甚至，谷川还给刘艺菲写了一个欠条。

    写完欠条之后，谷川就没有之前那么矜持了，十分自来熟地问道：“对了，你能给我引荐一下你们学校的田庄庄老师吗？”

    刘艺菲挑眉。

    这人够没脸没皮的，刚拉扯完欠账的问题，转头就让她帮忙。

    刘艺菲警惕地说道：“我警告你，不要骗我们学校的老师，不然我可报警了。”

    谷川牙疼。

    除了报警你还会做什么？

    “你先还我八十！”刘艺菲说道。

    “啊？”

    刘艺菲凶巴巴地说道：“我找了你这么久，你必须还我点钱！”

    就算只有八十也要。

    她这么费劲的找这个家伙，找到了一分钱都要不回来，那岂不是白找了？

    谷川无奈。

    连八十块你都要，太小气了。

    他还是喜欢当初那个，眼睛都不眨一下，立马掏出6315美元给他的小姑娘。

    “给你给你！”

    谷川不情不愿地数出来八十块给刘艺菲，表情郁闷。

    刘艺菲接过这皱巴巴的八十块，有点欣喜。
content_en:
"This phone is not mine."

    "Oh?"

    "I cheated on this phone." Tanichuan said.

    Liu Yifei's rising anger suddenly stopped.

    Well, this reason is quite believable.

    Tanichuan had a smile on his face and looked very sincere.

    Liu Yifei took out her mobile phone and fumbled around, seeming to be dialing some number.

    "Oh! Just wait!"

    Tanichuan quickly held down Liu Yifei's hand, preventing her from making the call to the police.

    "Okay, okay, I'll give you my cell phone number." Tanichuan reluctantly reported a number to Liu Yifei. Liu Yifei called and it turned out to be Tanichuan. She didn't lie again this time.

    Tanichuan smiled and said: "Actually, I am more accustomed to using the Penguin than the phone."

    Liu Yifei snorted coldly.

    She has no good feelings toward people who cheat her out of money.

    "Remember to pay back the money, otherwise I will definitely call the police." Liu Yifei said fiercely.

    "Give it back." Tanichuan nodded.

    Tanichuan even wrote an IOU to Liu Yifei.

    After writing the IOU, Tanichuan was no longer as reserved as before, and asked very familiarly: "By the way, can you introduce me to Teacher Tianzhuangzhuang in your school?"

    Liu Yifei raised her eyebrows.

    This person was so shameless that he just turned around and asked her for help after he finished dealing with the debt issue.

    Liu Yifei said vigilantly: "I warn you, don't lie to the teachers in our school, otherwise I will call the police."

    Tanichuan has a toothache.

    What else would you do besides calling the police?

    "You pay me eighty first!" Liu Yifei said.

    "Huh?"

    Liu Yifei said fiercely: "I have been looking for you for so long, you must pay me back!"

    Even if it’s only eighty.

    She worked so hard to find this guy, and even if she didn't get back even a penny after finding him, wouldn't it be in vain?

    Tanichuan was helpless.

    You're too stingy to ask for even 80 yuan.

    He still liked the girl from before, who immediately took out $6,315 and gave it to him without blinking an eye.

    "Here you go!"

    Tanichuan reluctantly counted out eighty yuan and gave it to Liu Yifei with a depressed expression.

    Liu Yifei took the crumpled eighty yuan and was a little happy.
title_en: Chapter 4: People are poor and have short ambitions, so they cheat
